subject: Bridge helper integration: set swizzle_valid; sampler view format
body: Reviewed the current nord2_metal_bridge.c helper wiring (read-only). Two concrete fixes before it can be considered correct: (1) struct n2t_texture_layout gained uint32_t swizzle_valid immediately before swizzle_word. The bridge currently sets l.swizzle_word from TEGU_PIPELINE_D2_SWIZZLE but leaves swizzle_valid=0, so a nonzero descriptor swizzle is silently ignored and identity is emitted. Set l.swizzle_valid = (swizzle_word!=0) or carry an explicit wire validity bit; if 0, identity/default is intended. (2) n2t_sampler_pack_for_format must receive the VIEW format info (l.view_format ? l.view_format : l.format), not allocation format, for ClampToZero alpha and integer-border class. Current bridge calls n2t_format_query(l.format,&fi). Also the sidecar n2r path is now per-binding authoritative; bridge should pass n2r_texture_resources and use n2r_build_v2 only for supplied entries, and retain full memory.bytes. No phone/build/commit by me.
